podcast.title: Future of Music Business (2009)
podcast.body: Owl City was seen by his label, Universal Republic, as "representing the future of our business." His manager highlighted that "people feel like they know Owl City, like they've got a direct connection to him, because of how he approaches his connection with them online." This illustrates the growing importance of direct artist-fan connection through social media. "representing the future of our business."
